label: Now Developing
items: ASEAN adopted migrant-recruitment safeguards and anti-scam principles before the Philippines handed the chair to Singapore; maritime code talks remain unfinished.
Trump described a major US-Philippines trade deal, while Manila characterized it as an economic-cooperation understanding without public signed terms.
